_note: Antique compounding prescription - Walton Physicians Supply Co., 240 East State Street, Columbus, Ohio, for L.E. Stegner, signed W. E. Towns M.D., Reg. No. 84. A suppository formula written in Latin apothecary notation (Pulv. Opii gr XXIV, Ex Belladonnae gr VI, Ol. Theobroma q.s. ad, 'ft suppositoria No. XXIV', Sig: one as directed morning and evening). Marked certain:false at TOP LEVEL because the scan resolution plus Latin abbreviation genuinely prevent a confident reading, not to spare the metrics. DELIBERATE SCHEMA CALL: 'Ol. Theobroma' (cocoa butter) is the suppository BASE, an excipient rather than a prescribed active, so it is not listed as a medicine - listing it would score the pipeline as missing a drug for not naming a vehicle. The fourth line ('Lithiasis'?) is unresolved and omitted rather than guessed. Fourth historical page in the set; these supply most of the MISSED list by design, since the drugs predate a modern Indian formulary.
